input.quote: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant in section 2(a) runs to \"Client\" only — Client is defined in the preamble as Mortgage Logic.com, Inc. alone, so affiliates are not covered and there is no notice mechanic to add them. Section 15 bars either party from assigning or transferring rights without consent (the only carve-out being an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate), so the licence is not transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction. Both fallback elements therefore fail. We target the fallback with one short subsection in section 2 adding affiliate coverage on written notice and a Client-side successor transfer right expressed as \"without TrueLink's approval\", which avoids any notwithstanding override of section 15 and does not expand TrueLink's assignment rights.

ops.text: Affiliates and Transfer. The license granted under section 2(a) extends to any affiliate of Client identified in a written notice from Client to TrueLink, and Client may transfer this license to a successor in a merger or acquisition without TrueLink's approval.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The grant runs to Client alone and the licence cannot follow us in a corporate transaction, so we added a short subsection extending it to affiliates we identify by written notice and permitting transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition without TrueLink's approval. This is our fallback licence-scope position.
proposal.summary: Add affiliate coverage on written notice and successor transfer of the licence

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.
